Policies and Initiatives.title: Imarticus Learning acquires Singapore-based BELLS Institute of Higher Learning
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Imarticus Learning has acquired Singapore-based BELLS Institute of Higher Learning, combining two institutions focused on professional education and workforce development. The acquisition expands Imarticus Learning's reach, adding BELLS' network of over 150,000 alumni and seven training centres across Singapore. The combined organization now has over 1,100 employees and operates from more than 25 offices.

Policies and Initiatives.title: JanAI shares roadmap to prepare India’s higher education system for an AI-driven economy
Policies and Initiatives.summary: JanAI has shared a draft report with NITI Aayog to prepare India's higher education system for an AI-driven economy. The report identifies gaps in assessment, faculty preparedness, and industry alignment, and recommends curriculum reforms and national AI capability frameworks. The initiative aims to strengthen human capabilities alongside technology adoption to ensure future readiness.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Paytm founder Vijay Shekhar Sharma calls AI a once-in-a-generation opportunity for India
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Paytm founder Vijay Shekhar Sharma views artificial intelligence as a significant opportunity for India to create new jobs and drive economic growth. He believes government initiatives like the IndiaAI Mission can help the country achieve global leadership in AI. Sharma emphasizes the need for focus and ambition to capitalize on this opportunity and drive technological progress.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Pronto widens AI camera rollout in homes with ‘Verified’ offering
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Pronto is expanding its use of wearable cameras in customers' homes through its "Pronto Verified" service, which records service sessions and uses anonymized footage for AI training. The service is opt-in, allowing customers to choose whether to participate. Pronto Verified is an expansion of the company's Physical AI initiative, which was first piloted in May to collect real-world data for AI models.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Healthtech startup CARPL.ai raises $10 Mn Series A led by IFC
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Healthtech startup CARPL.ai has raised $10 million in a Series A funding round led by the International Finance Corporation (IFC), with participation from existing investors. This brings the company's total funding to $16 million, following a $6 million raise in 2023. The new capital will be used to enhance the company's technology, accelerate product development, and expand its global sales and delivery teams.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startups this week [July 06 - July 11]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: 19 Indian startups raised nearly $271 million in funding this week, with 6 growth-stage and 13 early-stage deals. This amount surpasses the $70.4 million raised by 18 startups in the previous week. The week also saw three acquisitions, leadership changes, and other notable developments in the Indian startup ecosystem.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Responsible AI emerges as a strategic imperative for Indian businesses amid evolving global regulations
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology is leading a push for responsible AI governance, shifting from unregulated deployment to accountable adoption. This comes as global regulations tighten, making transparency, fairness, and explainability crucial for businesses to avoid compliance gaps and reputational damage. Indian businesses must now prioritize responsible AI to remain competitive and compliant.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startups this week [June 29 - July 04]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startups raised nearly $137 million in funding this week, with 25 startups securing investments across 5 growth-stage and 19 early-stage deals. The week also saw four acquisitions, leadership changes, and fund launches, but the funding amount was significantly lower than the $1.1 billion raised by 20 startups the previous week. This marks a notable decrease in funding compared to the previous week's totals.

Policies and Initiatives.title: IAMAI launches AI Council of India to drive synergy across India's AI ecosystem
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The AI Council of India (AICI) has been launched to unite India's AI sector and drive synergy among government, industry, academia, and startups. The council aims to advance AI research, strengthen infrastructure, and promote applied AI solutions. AICI plans to host a national AI summit and establish university clubs to nurture future talent and accelerate India's AI leadership.

Policies and Initiatives.title: MeitY, UP to set up three AI Centres of Excellence under IndiaAI Mission
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and the state of Uttar Pradesh (UP) are collaborating to establish three AI Centres of Excellence. These centres will be set up under the IndiaAI Mission, aiming to promote artificial intelligence development in the country. The initiative is expected to drive AI innovation and growth in India.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Info Edge’s AI and deeptech portfolio crosses Rs 1,800 Cr in value
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Info Edge, the parent company of Naukri.com, has invested over Rs 1,000 crore in 54 AI and deeptech startups since 2020. The company's investment vehicles have deployed Rs 614 crore in 28 AI startups and Rs 455 crore in 30 deeptech firms. Info Edge's AI and deeptech portfolio is now valued at over Rs 1,800 crore.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India looking to scale up local AI infrastructure; NITI to review
Policies and Initiatives.summary: NITI Aayog is working to identify gaps in India's AI ecosystem and recommend measures to strengthen its independent AI development and deployment capabilities. This effort aims to scale up local AI infrastructure, potentially expanding the existing India AI Mission. The review by NITI Aayog is a step towards bolstering India's AI capabilities.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Vaishnaw expects more companies to start production of memory chips in India
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is expected to see increased investments in memory chip manufacturing due to growing demand for AI and data centre storage. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw anticipates more companies will start producing memory chips in the country. The India Semiconductor Mission aims to boost domestic semiconductor capacity through new fabs, design, and equipment manufacturing.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startups this week [June 8  - June 13]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startups raised around $253.34 million in funding this week, with 6 growth-stage deals, 16 early-stage deals, and 5 undisclosed deals. This amount surpasses the $165.3 million secured by 17 startups in the previous week. A total of 27 Indian startups received funding between June 8 and June 13.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India, Nepal partner to advance multilingual AI and digital public infrastructure
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's Digital India BHASHINI Division and Kathmandu University have partnered to develop multilingual AI resources and digital public infrastructure. The collaboration aims to preserve linguistic heritage and improve digital inclusion. The partnership will also strengthen technological cooperation between India and Nepal.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Indian startup leaders, UK minister discuss future of AI collaboration
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startup founders met with UK Minister for AI and Online Safety, Kanishka Narayan, to discuss future AI collaboration. The meeting took place during the Cambridge India Business Dialogue as part of the Startup Policy Forum's UK Startup Safari delegation. This gathering aimed to foster cooperation between Indian startups and the UK in the field of artificial intelligence.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startups this week [May 25 - May 30]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: 15 Indian startups raised around $75.35 million in funding this week, with 3 growth-stage deals and 9 early-stage deals. This amount is lower than the $128.36 million secured by 14 startups in the previous week. The funding rounds included a mix of disclosed and undisclosed deals, with 2 startups keeping their funding amounts private.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Snabbit confirms exploring physical AI proposal with Human Archive, denies home rollout
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Snabbit, a home services startup, was approached by Human Archive to explore a physical AI proposal, but ultimately decided not to move forward. Human Archive is a startup that builds datasets for embodied intelligence and robotics systems. Snabbit has denied plans for a home rollout of physical AI, distinguishing itself from another startup, Pronto, which is experimenting with Physical AI-linked data collection.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Centre forms high-level inter-ministerial body to steer AI governance strategy
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India has formed a high-level inter-ministerial body called AIGEG, headed by Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, to guide the nation's AI governance strategy. AIGEG will coordinate policies across ministries and regulators, and assess AI's impact on the labor market. The group will develop a roadmap for AI deployment over the next decade.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Brandworks Technologies Signs MoU with MeitY Startup Hub to Boost AI-Led Electronics...
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Brandworks Technologies has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with MeitY Startup Hub to promote AI-led electronics manufacturing. The partnership aims to foster innovation and growth in the electronics sector through artificial intelligence. This collaboration is expected to boost the development of AI-driven electronics in India.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Govt forms high-level AI governance panel to steer policy framework; Vaishnaw to lead
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government has formed a high-level inter-ministerial body, the AI Governance and Economic Group (AIGEG), to oversee the country's artificial intelligence policy framework. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw will lead the panel, which will serve as the central institutional mechanism for AI governance, policy development, and coordination. The AIGEG aims to steer India's AI policy framework, with MeitY constituting the group.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Memory chip shortage due to AI buildout, not West Asia conflict, says IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw attributes the memory chip shortage to the AI buildout, rather than the West Asia conflict. The Indian government is actively promoting semiconductor manufacturing, with the Prime Minister inaugurating the country's first semiconductor plant last month and another one scheduled for next month. This indicates a positive approach by the government towards addressing semiconductor concerns.

Policies and Initiatives.title: UP govt scraps Rs 25,000-crore MoU with Puch AI: ‘Firm lacks net worth, financial linkages’
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has canceled a Rs 25,000-crore Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Puch AI due to the company's lack of net worth and financial linkages. The decision was made after reviewing the firm's financial capabilities, which were deemed insufficient to support the massive investment. The scrapped MoU was initially intended to facilitate a significant investment in the state.

Policies and Initiatives.title: IndiaAI Mission onboards 38,231 GPUs, 190 projects approved: Jitin Prasada
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IndiaAI Mission has onboarded 38,231 GPUs and approved 190 projects to enhance the country's artificial intelligence ecosystem. The mission aims to strengthen the nation's AI capabilities. Additionally, the Semicon India Programme has cleared 10 semiconductor units to promote domestic chip manufacturing.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Mar 16 - Mar 21]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startups raised around $330.2 million in funding this week, with 6 growth-stage deals securing $272.1 million and 20 early-stage deals securing the remaining amount. This represents a significant increase from the previous week, when 22 startups collectively secured about $162.98 million. The total funding this week was distributed across 26 Indian startups.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Mar 09 - Mar 14]
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian startups raised around $162.98 million this week, with 6 growth-stage and 16 early-stage deals. This amount surpasses the $105.08 million secured by 14 startups in the previous week. Growth-stage startups accounted for the majority of the funding, raising $120.3 million.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: $240 billion investment pledged by top firms
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Top firms including Reliance Industries, Google, and Tata Group pledged $240 billion in investments at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. Over $200 billion of this investment will target AI infrastructure, hardware, and applications. The summit drew 6 lakh attendees from 100 countries, aiming to strengthen India's sovereign compute capacity and national AI infrastructure.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Govt weighs new cyber framework as Airtel unveils AI Threat Research Centre
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is planning new cybersecurity laws to combat AI-powered threats. Airtel has unveiled an AI Threat Research Centre in partnership with Zscaler to monitor and combat these threats. The centre will track 500 billion daily transactions to identify potential security risks.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India unveils frontier AI commitments to drive measurable outcomes
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India has announced a voluntary framework to drive AI adoption, focusing on transparency and multilingual capabilities. The framework aims to promote measurable outcomes in AI development and usage. The move is part of the government's efforts to sharpen its regulatory approach to artificial intelligence.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Centre plans market platform for AI startups in next mission phase: MeitY
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) plans to create a market platform for AI startups as part of its next phase. This move comes after the ministry's first large-scale AI initiative, which will inform next year's plans through incorporated feedback on challenges faced. The initiative is part of the IndiaAI Mission, led by Abhishek Singh, additional secretary of MeitY.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India pitches inclusive AI roadmap to the world
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India has introduced a voluntary AI roadmap that promotes inclusive and responsible development. Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled guidelines that encourage signatories to achieve measurable outcomes in these areas. The initiative aims to push for a more equitable approach to AI development globally.

Policies and Initiatives.title: PM Modi presents ‘MANAV Vision’ framework for AI at India AI Impact Summit 2026; flags deepfake threat
Policies and Initiatives.summary: PM Modi presented the 'MANAV Vision' framework for AI at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, emphasizing a human-centric approach with a focus on ethics and accountability. The framework aims to address the threat of deepfakes and promote trust in artificial intelligence. It prioritizes data sovereignty and watermarking norms to ensure responsible AI development.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India giving necessary policy backing to accelerate AI, semiconductor push, highlights MeitY Secretary
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is entering a crucial phase in its semiconductor and AI development, driven by sustained policy support and long-term investments. The government aims to build sovereign capabilities in these areas through competitive compute pricing and strategic investments. Secretary of MeitY S. Krishnan highlighted the importance of policy backing in accelerating India's AI and semiconductor push.

Policies and Initiatives.title: IndiaAI Mission join hands with Coursera to offer ‘YUVA AI for ALL’ foundational course on AI
Policies and Initiatives.summary: IndiaAI Mission has partnered with Coursera to offer a free foundational AI course called "YUVA AI for ALL" to equip citizens with essential artificial intelligence skills. The course covers AI applications, safety, and ethics, and learners will receive a government certificate upon completion. This initiative supports India's goal of becoming an AI-enabled nation.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Indian govt issues new AI content rules for social media, sets 3-hour takedown window
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government has introduced new rules for social media platforms regarding AI-generated content, requiring them to use automated tools to detect and prevent its circulation. Platforms must take down such content within a 3-hour window. The revised framework aims to regulate the spread of illegal AI-generated content on social media.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India's sovereign AI model strategy delivering results
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's sovereign AI model strategy is yielding positive results, according to Union Electronics and IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. He praised a homegrown startup, Sarvam AI, for releasing an advanced AI model. The success of this strategy highlights the potential of India's domestic AI development efforts.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India-US interim trade deal to boost access to advanced GPUs, data centre equipment
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India and the US are finalising an interim trade framework to increase access to advanced GPUs and data centre equipment. The agreement aims to create opportunities for startups, service providers, and the AI ecosystem. This trade deal is expected to boost India's access to critical technologies, according to Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Agnihotri bats for drone, robotics push at tech fest
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Deputy CM Agnihotri emphasized the need for IIIT Una to focus on drone technology and robotics at a tech fest. He praised the institution's skill development courses and new MSc mathematics program, and MoUs were signed to enhance academic and research collaboration. Agnihotri also stressed the importance of technology fairs and government support for a thriving digital ecosystem.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Next-Gen chips, real-world challenges: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's second-phase semiconductor mission, India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, aims to achieve globally competitive outcomes. The mission must match industry readiness with scaling to turn mega-fabs and rare earth plans into reality. According to IESA President Ashok Chandak, this is crucial for the mission's success.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India Offers Zero Taxes Until 2045 to Lure Global AI Firms
Policies and Initiatives.summary: As the global race to build AI infrastructure accelerates, India has offered foreign cloud providers zero taxes through 2047 on services sold outside the country if they run those workloads from Indian data centres. This is expected to accelerate India's rise in the AI space.

Policies and Initiatives.title: New Panel To Review Impact Of AI On Services Sector: Nirmala Sitharaman
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is taking precautions to protect its rapidly expanding workforce from the ill-effects of AI's slow takeover. This new panel is a high-powered Education to Employment and Enterprises Standing Committee that will recommend measures that focus on services sector as a core driver of economic growth.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Budget 2026 signals AI-led growth, skilling push; industry calls for faster execution
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026 aims to drive growth through AI and skilling initiatives, with a focus on emerging sectors. Key initiatives include the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 and industry-led research centres. The budget also proposes setting up AVGC content creator labs in schools and colleges to promote employment in these areas.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India's AI and semiconductor foray marks crucial shift in employment landscape
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's foray into AI and semiconductor sectors marks a significant shift in the employment landscape, requiring a highly skilled workforce for top roles. Reskilling and upskilling are necessary to tap into the domestic talent pool. Close coordination with the industry ecosystem is crucial to achieve this.

Policies and Initiatives.title: How AI is helping researchers revive cultural heritage; Explained
Policies and Initiatives.summary: AI is aiding researchers in reviving cultural heritage through digitization efforts. In India, over 10 crore pages of historical documents are now available online via the Abhilekh Patal portal, a significant milestone in heritage preservation. This digital archive is a result of the National Archives' prioritization of digitization to make cultural heritage more accessible.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 60% of businesses confident in scaling AI, but gaps remain: Nasscom Report
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Indian businesses are increasingly adopting Responsible AI, with 30% having mature practices and 45% implementing formal frameworks, marking a significant increase from 2023. Despite 60% of businesses being confident in scaling AI, challenges such as hallucinations and privacy concerns persist. Businesses with higher AI maturity are better prepared for emerging technologies, but require framework updates for advanced AI systems.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Dell, NxtGen to build 'India’s largest AI training cluster' under sovereign cloud
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Dell and NxtGen are collaborating to build India's largest AI training cluster under a sovereign cloud project. The project will utilize over 4,000 NVIDIA GPUs to enhance domestic AI computing capabilities. This initiative aims to support enterprises, startups, academia, and government entities.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI’s Copyright Reckoning: Can India Balance Creators And Code?
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Copyright holders, including Hollywood studios and book publishers, are resisting AI training due to concerns over intellectual property rights. This pushback is part of a larger debate about balancing the interests of creators with the development of AI code. India is now faced with the challenge of finding a balance between these two competing interests.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI-led upskilling creates new pathways for women in India’s STEM ecosystem
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Women's STEM education in India is growing, with AI-led upskilling creating new tech roles. Despite this, women's presence in the workforce, particularly in manufacturing and electric mobility, remains low. Bridging the education-to-employment gap through internships and inclusive workplaces is crucial for long-term growth.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 'India in 1st league of AI nations, not a follower': IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw at Davos; focus on deployment over large models
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has declared the country a leader in artificial intelligence, rather than a follower. He emphasized a focus on deploying AI on a large scale, prioritizing practical implementation over developing massive AI models. This approach positions India as a major player in the global AI landscape.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 60% AI-ready Firms Mature on Responsible AI, Gaps Persist: Nasscom Report
Policies and Initiatives.summary: A Nasscom report finds that 60% of AI-ready firms have matured in their adoption of responsible AI, but gaps persist. Key challenges include data quality, regulatory uncertainty, and hallucinations, which hinder the advancement of responsible AI frameworks. Despite progress, these gaps must be addressed for further growth and development.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Tech an enabler, future success will rely on strong base of trust: Nasscom VP on AI governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Nasscom VP Aggarwal views technology as a great enabler, believing AI can be used to minimize and prevent harms generated by its use. There is a growing emphasis on setting "technology-led guardrails" to mitigate potential issues. This approach prioritizes proactive measures over reactive regulations in AI governance.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI adoption to generate $1.7 trillion for India by 2035: KPMG report
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's adoption of artificial intelligence is expected to generate $1.7 trillion in economic value by 2035. This growth will be driven by investments in semiconductors, strong data governance, and rapid adoption across various sectors. A KPMG report released at the World Economic Forum in Davos forecasts this significant economic boost.

Policies and Initiatives.title: India to See Up To $150 Bn AI Infrastructure Investments in 2026: Ashwini Vaishnaw
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the country is expected to see significant investments in AI infrastructure, potentially reaching up to $150 billion in 2026. This investment is part of India's escalated AI ambitions, as stated at the World Economic Forum. The large-scale investment aims to boost India's AI capabilities and infrastructure.

Policies and Initiatives.title: “Not Second Tier”: Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Defends India’s AI Ambition at Davos
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India's approach to artificial intelligence was highlighted at the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in Davos. Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw defended India's AI ambition, emphasizing its significance on a global scale. Vaishnaw's statement aimed to establish India as a major player in the AI sector, dispelling any notion of it being "second tier".

Policies and Initiatives.title: Artificial intelligence: Reshaping global markets and opening India’s next growth frontier
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming global equity markets, driven by US tech firms. India is emerging as a key AI infrastructure growth hub due to supportive policies, abundant talent, and increasing data centre investments. This development is poised to unlock India's next growth frontier amidst rising valuation concerns in the global market.

Policies and Initiatives.title: GLC and Schoolnet India conclude EcoInnovators Ideathon 2026 on AI for sustainability
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The EcoInnovators Ideathon 2026, a national student innovation challenge, concluded with grand finales for its school and college tracks, focusing on Artificial Intelligence for sustainability. The initiative is recognized by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology as a pre-summit event of the IndiaAI Impact Summit 2026. The event was organized by the Global Learning Council in partnership with Schoolnet India and other companies to empower India's youth to develop AI-based solutions.

Policies and Initiatives.title: AI will define next phase of India’s digital growth: DoT Secretary
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Artificial intelligence will drive India's next phase of digital growth, according to DoT Secretary Amit Agrawal. India is committed to responsible AI development and ASEAN digital cooperation, with a focus on rapid telecom expansion and digital public infrastructure. The country is also implementing capacity-building initiatives to support this growth.

Policies and Initiatives.title: A Timely Pivot: How GenAI Allowed SpeakX To Find A New Edtech Mission
Policies and Initiatives.summary: SpeakX, an edtech company, has found a new mission thanks to the capabilities of GenAI. The company is leveraging AI to improve English language skills in India, where English proficiency is highly valued. GenAI has enabled SpeakX to pivot and expand its offerings in the edtech space.

Policies and Initiatives.title: X Corp acknowledges obscene Grok AI content, assures compliance with Indian law
Policies and Initiatives.summary: X Corp, run by Elon Musk, has acknowledged the presence of obscene content generated by its Grok AI chatbot. The company has assured compliance with Indian laws after government action was taken. Thousands of posts were blocked and hundreds of accounts were deleted in response to a directive from India's MeitY.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Why India organisations need federated data management
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India aims to achieve a trillion-dollar digital economy by 2030, driven by artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things. To support this goal, federated data management is crucial as it enables efficient data access and analysis, reducing costs and enhancing security. This approach is vital for India's digital future and supports AI development.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Global leaders & top tech executives to attend AI summit
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Global leaders and top tech executives will attend an AI summit, with around 100 executives from tech firms and ministers from approximately 50 countries participating. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will address the event, including a leaders plenary and a CEO roundtable. The summit will bring together key figures from around the world to discuss AI.

Policies and Initiatives.title: How National Deep Tech Startup Policy can Help Start a New Era in Innovation
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is home to over 3,000 deep-tech startups, focusing on innovations in areas like AI, big data, and blockchain, with potential to contribute $450-500 billion to the economy by 2025. These startups are transforming industries such as agriculture, life sciences, and aerospace with novel technology solutions. A national deep tech startup policy can help foster the growth of this emerging sector, driving innovation and economic growth.

Events.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: PM Modi to lead opening ceremony - Important entry protocols, traffic advisory for February 19
Events.summary: PM Modi will lead the opening ceremony of the India AI Impact Summit 2026 on February 19 at 9:40 AM. The ceremony will also be addressed by the President of France, the Secretary-General of the United Nations, and top industry leaders. The event is scheduled to take place on February 19, with specific entry protocols and traffic advisories in place.

Events.title: AI Impact Summit 2026: PM Modi hails India as rising global AI powerhouse, calls it a defining moment
Events.summary: India is hosting the India AI Impact Summit Expo 2026, which PM Modi sees as a defining moment for the country's AI leadership. The event will focus on human-centric AI progress and global collaboration for a progressive future. India is being hailed as a rising global AI powerhouse at the summit.

Events.title: GBS 2026: India to host world’s largest AI summit; AI to drive ‘Fifth Industrial Revolution,’ says Ashwini Vaishnaw | ET NOW Global Business Summit 2026
Events.summary: India will host the world's largest AI summit, GBS 2026, with over 20 heads of state and 100 global leaders in attendance. The summit will focus on AI's transformative impact, sovereign models, and the shift from IT services to AI-driven capabilities. AI is expected to drive the 'Fifth Industrial Revolution', according to Ashwini Vaishnaw.

Events.title: Delhi to get major facelift as NDMC steps up preparations for upcoming India-AI Impact Summit
Events.summary: The New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) is preparing for the upcoming India-AI Impact Summit by giving Delhi a major facelift. The preparations are part of the city's efforts to host the summit, which is expected to bring significant attention to the city. Delhi's infrastructure and amenities will be upgraded as part of the facelift.

Events.title: Capital One India: Driving innovation with a country-wide Hackathon and AI Summit
Events.summary: Capital One India is hosting a nationwide hackathon and AI summit to drive innovation and address real-world challenges. The event aims to bring together talent, technology, and purpose to build solutions. The hackathon and summit will provide a platform for participants to showcase their skills and creativity.

Events.title: India–AI Impact Summit 2026
Events.summary: The India–AI Impact Summit 2026 is an upcoming event focused on artificial intelligence. Details about the summit, including its agenda and speakers, are not provided in the given content. The event is expected to discuss the impact of AI on various sectors in India.

Events.title: Digital India Ask Our Experts | Episode 41 | India AI Impact Summit 2026
Events.summary: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is hosting an episode of "Digital India Ask Our Experts". This episode, numbered 41, aims to discuss AI's impact in India. The summit brings together experts to share knowledge and insights on AI's role in India's digital transformation.

Major AI Developments.title: How AI agents are transforming India's financial services sector
Major AI Developments.summary: AI agents are being used in India's financial services sector to perform tasks such as reading loan documents and communicating with customers in their native language. This shift aims to make finance more accessible and efficient, but also raises concerns about data, security, and trust. The use of AI in finance could transform the sector by automating tasks that previously required human intervention.

Major AI Developments.title: AI won’t create India’s jobs crisis, but it could deepen it
Major AI Developments.summary: India's job market is already challenging, with few middle-skill opportunities, and AI may exacerbate the issue by threatening cognitive jobs. The country needs to create more productive non-farm work and expand tech-complementary roles to mitigate the impact. Targeted AI skilling is essential to help India secure its demographic dividend and address the existing skills divide.

Major AI Developments.title: PM Modi’s AI bet: Train 1 crore youth in one year
Major AI Developments.summary: PM Modi aims to train 1 crore youth in AI within a year. Meanwhile, startups announced $146 million in funding across 15 deals this week, a decrease from $323 million the previous week. The funding decline may not impact the government's AI training initiative.

Major AI Developments.title: Global innovation hub to AI skill training for 1 Cr youth: PM Modi outlines nation’s tech ambitions
Major AI Developments.summary: PM Modi announced plans to establish a global innovation hub for AI skill training, aiming to benefit 1 crore youth. He highlighted the nation's tech ambitions, citing rapid growth in areas like artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and space. The initiative is part of India's efforts to expand its technological capabilities and foster innovation.

Major AI Developments.title: From AI consumer to AI producer: Why India must build, not just use, the AI economy
Major AI Developments.summary: India has a large AI user base but lacks AI production, relying on consumption rather than creation. To change this, India needs to build AI platforms that cover the full model lifecycle, allowing the country to retain decision-making and economic value. By leveraging its strengths in talent and data, India can invest in domestic AI development and create a thriving AI software industry.

Major AI Developments.title: AI data-centre boom drives surge in demand for core engineers in India
Major AI Developments.summary: India's growing AI data-centre ecosystem is driving a surge in demand for core engineers, particularly mechanical, electrical, and cooling engineers. This increased demand is resulting in sharply rising salaries for these professionals. The AI data-centre boom is creating new job opportunities in India's engineering sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Beyond algorithms: Why AI success is shaped by people, not platforms
Major AI Developments.summary: AI success is driven by people, not just technology, and empowering employees is crucial for effective AI transformation. Developing trust and awareness of AI's potential is essential for its successful integration in organizations. A human-centric approach, focusing on continuous learning and skill enhancement, is necessary for AI to deliver meaningful benefits.

Major AI Developments.title: Accel raises $550 Mn India fund, takes India corpus to $1.2 Bn in 18 months
Major AI Developments.summary: US-based venture capital firm Accel has raised a $550 million early-stage fund for India, taking its total India corpus to $1.2 billion over the past 18 months. This is Accel's ninth early-stage fund for the country and part of a larger $3.5 billion global fundraise across four new funds. The new fund is the firm's second major investment in India in the past year, following a $650 million fund launched previously.

Major AI Developments.title: Taiwan's Foxconn reports 35% rise in Q2 profit on AI demand, beats forecasts
Major AI Developments.summary: Foxconn reported a 35% rise in Q2 profit, driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence products, beating forecasts. The company expects continued growth due to sustained AI demand, driving expansion this year. Foxconn is also expanding its manufacturing presence in India and Mexico, with its shares rising ahead of the earnings announcement.

Major AI Developments.title: India advances to Global AI power status with innovative governance model
Major AI Developments.summary: India is emerging as a major player in artificial intelligence through a combination of large-scale public investment and shared computing facilities. The country's innovative governance model aims to balance innovation with democratic safeguards. This approach is helping India advance to a global AI power status.

Major AI Developments.title: India must shape its AI journey rather than be shaped by default
Major AI Developments.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized the need for India to proactively shape its artificial intelligence journey, rather than letting the technology dictate the financial sector's development. According to Malhotra, adopting AI requires a complete transformation in risk evaluation, customer service, capital pricing, and operational organization. This transformation is necessary to effectively integrate AI into the financial sector.

Major AI Developments.title: TCS, Google Cloud launch Gemini Experience Center in Mexico City
Major AI Developments.summary: TCS and Google Cloud have launched a Gemini Experience Center in Mexico City, their second in Latin America and ninth globally. The facility will utilize AI agents and industry-specific solutions to enhance innovation, productivity, and data-driven decision-making. This center is part of a broader effort to support organisations in improving their operations through technology.

Major AI Developments.title: India to be key player in AI and biotechnology-led industrial revolution
Major AI Developments.summary: India is expected to play a key role in the next industrial revolution, driven by artificial intelligence and biotechnology. According to Union Minister of State Dr Jitendra Singh, the country is poised to become a major force in this revolution. India's growth in these areas will likely have a significant impact on its industrial development.

Major AI Developments.title: Info Edge’s Shiksha faces AI traffic headwinds as Q1 billings fall 23%
Major AI Developments.summary: Info Edge's education business Shiksha saw a 22.8% decline in Q1 billings to Rs 35 crore, with revenue falling 11.9% to Rs 44 crore, due in part to changes in Google search driven by AI. The company's operating PBT declined 48.8% year-on-year to Rs 3 crore, with cash from operations at a negative Rs 7 crore. Shiksha faced traffic and demand-related headwinds in Q1 FY27, attributed to the rise of AI-generated search experiences.

Major AI Developments.title: Building AI won't save your job—2 in 3 Indian AI workers expect layoffs soon, says report
Major AI Developments.summary: A survey of Indian AI and ML professionals found that 66% expect layoffs soon. This level of anxiety is nearly as high as that of roles AI was expected to replace. The findings suggest that working in AI may not be a guarantee against job loss, contrary to common assumptions.

Major AI Developments.title: AI is reimagining service companies; Ola Electric narrows loss in Q1
Major AI Developments.summary: Northbound Advisors is developing a proprietary AI tool in partnership with another company, utilizing eight years of data from various service engagements. The tool is being trained on a range of areas, including diligences, CFO advisory, legal, tax, and risk engagements. This AI initiative aims to reimagine service companies, with Ola Electric also reporting a narrowed loss in its Q1.

Major AI Developments.title: Dell launches AI-ready Pro Precision workstations, introduces Deskside Agentic AI in India
Major AI Developments.summary: Dell has launched AI-ready Pro Precision workstations, designed to support artificial intelligence applications. The company has also introduced Deskside Agentic AI in India, expanding its AI offerings in the region. These launches aim to provide powerful computing solutions for professionals working with AI and data-intensive tasks.

Major AI Developments.title: Government examines Meta’s recommendation system for intermediary status
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian government is examining Meta's recommendation systems and paid content promotion to determine if they align with the company's intermediary status under the IT Act. The review is prompted by concerns over content moderation, deepfakes, and unlabelled AI content. The government's examination aims to assess Meta's compliance with Indian regulations.

Major AI Developments.title: India may see productivity gains from AI, says Nilekani
Major AI Developments.summary: Nandan Nilekani predicts India will become a leader in applied artificial intelligence, driving productivity and inclusivity for its citizens. This shift is expected to impact large corporations, potentially leading to a rise in solo ventures and smaller enterprises. India may emerge as the world's AI use case hub, fostering economic transformation and new opportunities.

Major AI Developments.title: India’s healthcare AI race isn’t about bigger models. It’s about better diagnostics
Major AI Developments.summary: India's healthcare AI focus is shifting towards improving diagnostics rather than developing larger models. AI is expected to have a significant impact on the future of medicine, but its most valuable contribution will be beyond replacing doctors or automating clinical decisions. The technology aims to enhance medical capabilities, rather than substitute human professionals.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-related hiring amounted to 83100, 31,921 layoffs & attrition in India: Report; economists say ‘most firing cases….’
Major AI Developments.summary: India experienced significant AI-driven job growth with 83,100 hires, compared to 31,921 layoffs, according to a Nomura report. The report analyzed 69 cases across Asia from 2022 to August 2026. This data suggests a substantial net gain in AI-related employment in India during the period.

Major AI Developments.title: How STCH Is Modernising Apparel Manufacturing With AI & Factory OS
Major AI Developments.summary: STCH is utilizing AI and Factory OS to modernize apparel manufacturing, creating a technology layer for the industry. The company is helping brands generate hundreds of new designs using AI, enhancing the D2C fashion ecosystem in India. This integration of AI is transforming the manufacturing process, making it more efficient and trend-sensitive.

Major AI Developments.title: Freshworks turns profitable in Q2; Navigating the AI shift
Major AI Developments.summary: Freshworks reported a revenue increase to $237.4 million in Q2, up from $204.7 million in the same period last year. The company has also achieved profitability, marking a significant milestone. This growth comes as Freshworks navigates the shift towards AI integration.

Major AI Developments.title: Large firms to be net job losers, small businesses to drive employment: Nandan Nilekani
Major AI Developments.summary: Nandan Nilekani predicts that large firms will experience net job losses, while small businesses will drive employment growth. He believes the future of the Indian economy relies on its numerous small businesses, which are more resilient to AI disruptions. Small businesses are expected to be the primary drivers of employment due to their adaptability.

Major AI Developments.title: Who pays when an AI agent goes rogue? Indian law has no clear answer
Major AI Developments.summary: Recent disclosures by OpenAI and Anthropic have exposed a legal gap in Indian law regarding autonomous AI. There is currently no clear answer to who would be liable in the event of an AI agent causing harm. Indian law lacks specific provisions to address the accountability of rogue AI agents.

Major AI Developments.title: How Muthu Murugappan is building EID Parry's next growth engine with jaggery
Major AI Developments.summary: EID Parry is targeting the $5.8 billion global jaggery market with a new growth strategy. The company is combining traditional knowledge with technology, including India's first large-scale automated jaggery facility and AI-powered farming. This initiative also incorporates water conservation, aiming to drive future growth for the company.

Major AI Developments.title: Anthropic taps Amazon Bedrock for Claude's local data processing
Major AI Developments.summary: Anthropic will offer in-country inference for its Claude AI models in India, processing customer requests on local servers through Amazon Bedrock. This will keep data within the region, enhancing data residency for Indian organizations. The move addresses a key request from Indian businesses, enabling regulated sectors like banking and government to deploy advanced AI solutions.

Major AI Developments.title: Superleap raises Rs 36 Cr in pre-Series A round led by Peak XV’s Surge
Major AI Developments.summary: Superleap, an enterprise AI CRM startup, has raised Rs 36 crore ($3.7 million) in a pre-Series A funding round led by Peak XV's Surge. The funds will be used to expand its go-to-market operations, develop its AI-based CRM platform, and strengthen product capabilities. Founded in 2024, Superleap provides an AI-native CRM platform that automates sales tasks using revenue data, customer intelligence, and AI agents.

Major AI Developments.title: Agentic AI startup Kily raises Rs 30 Cr in round led by Sorin Investments
Major AI Developments.summary: Kily, an agentic enterprise AI startup, has raised Rs 30 crore ($3.1 million) in a funding round led by Sorin Investments, with participation from Razorpay and Wyser Capital. The fresh capital will be used to strengthen its product capabilities and expand operations. Kily develops AI agents to help brands manage operations across e-commerce and quick commerce platforms, and was founded in 2025 by Sankalp Mehrotra, Anurag Singh, and Sharad Chitlangia.

Major AI Developments.title: Anthropic expands India presence, adds in-country inference for Claude
Major AI Developments.summary: Anthropic is expanding its presence in India and introducing in-country inference capabilities for its AI model Claude. This move aims to improve the performance and accessibility of Claude in the Indian market. The expansion and addition of in-country inference will enhance the overall user experience for Claude users in India.

Major AI Developments.title: 69% of Indian enterprses plan to increase AI investments: Survey
Major AI Developments.summary: A survey has found that 69% of Indian enterprises plan to increase their investments in artificial intelligence. Indian businesses are shifting from experimental to widespread use of AI across their operations, driven by the benefits of AI adoption. However, challenges related to enterprise data readiness remain a significant obstacle to further expansion of AI initiatives.

Major AI Developments.title: Noise launches subscription-free REP Band, enters India’s screenless wearable segment
Major AI Developments.summary: Noise has launched the REP Band, a screenless wearable device offering subscription-free health monitoring and AI-powered wellness insights. The device is priced at Rs 9,999 as a special introductory offer and is tailored for Indian users. It provides continuous biometric tracking, entering Noise into India's screenless wearable segment.

Major AI Developments.title: Warehouse automation to humanoids: Addverb bets on India, CEO says physical AI race has begun
Major AI Developments.summary: Addverb is focusing on collaborative robots, quadrupeds, and humanoids as the next frontier of robotics. The company's CEO believes a global race in physical AI has begun, with India having a strong opportunity to build competitive companies. Addverb is betting on India to be a key player in this emerging technology.

Major AI Developments.title: The sandbox trap: Getting AI to work is easy, but scaling it changes everything
Major AI Developments.summary: Nearly half of Indian enterprises have live AI pilots, but only 15% are able to scale them. Scaling AI pilots is challenging due to operational friction, messy data, and unproven return on investment. Industry leaders are finding ways to overcome these obstacles and successfully implement AI on a larger scale.

Major AI Developments.title: Claude on Indian servers: What changes as Anthropic brings local AI processing via AWS
Major AI Developments.summary: Anthropic is bringing its Claude AI to Indian servers through a partnership with Amazon Web Services (AWS). The AI model will be available in the coming weeks via Amazon Bedrock, a platform for building generative AI applications. This move enables local AI processing, marking a significant development in Anthropic's expansion.

Major AI Developments.title: Google picks 20 AI startups for 2026 Play Accelerator India cohort
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has selected 20 AI-powered Indian startups for its 2026 Google Play Accelerator India program. The chosen startups will receive three months of equity-free mentorship, focusing on areas such as AI, security, and growth. This program aims to support the startups' global expansion efforts.

Major AI Developments.title: Google selects 20 AI startups for 2026 Play Accelerator India programme
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has selected 20 AI-powered Indian startups for the 2026 Play Accelerator India programme, a three-month equity-free initiative. The programme will provide mentorship on key areas such as AI integration, app quality, and growth. This will help the startups build scalable products for global markets.

Major AI Developments.title: Cognizant partners with OpenAI, brings global Codex hackathon to 10,000 employees in India
Major AI Developments.summary: Cognizant has partnered with OpenAI to launch a global Codex hackathon for its employees. The hackathon is open to 10,000 associates in six Indian cities, aiming to help them learn and develop applications using AI tools. This initiative is part of Cognizant's efforts to enhance its employees' skills in artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: AI application experts in high demand as companies pursue efficiency, customer focus
Major AI Developments.summary: Indian companies are prioritizing AI engineers who can apply the technology to solve customer issues, driving high demand for experts in this field. Firms are leveraging AI for both customer-facing solutions and internal process improvements, leading to a significant increase in demand for AI engineers. This shift reflects a growing need for talent that can bridge technology and business impact.

Major AI Developments.title: AI, data-driven lending to unlock India's ₹100 trillion MSME credit opportunity
Major AI Developments.summary: Industry leaders gathered to discuss AI and data-driven lending for India's ₹100 trillion MSME credit market, where intelligent underwriting is replacing traditional collateral-based lending. Digital footprints and alternative data are enabling faster and more inclusive credit decisions, while AI enhances operational efficiency and reduces manual intervention. Lentra's AI platform for cash flow-based MSME lending was also showcased at the event.

Major AI Developments.title: Applications open for VibeCode30: Searching for India’s most promising AI-native builders
Major AI Developments.summary: YourStory is launching VibeCode30 to recognize 30 promising AI-native builders in India. The initiative will unveil its first edition at TechSparks 2026, focusing on individuals and teams using AI-first tools to build innovative products. VibeCode30 aims to identify and showcase India's most talented AI-native builders.

Major AI Developments.title: Swiggy cuts Q1 FY27 losses by 34%; Shalini Neelankavil on leading in the AI era
Major AI Developments.summary: Swiggy reduced its Q1 FY27 losses by 34%. The company's quick commerce business, Instamart, achieved 53% year-over-year revenue growth, reaching Rs 1,232 in the first quarter. Instamart also hit a major breakeven milestone in May 2026.

Major AI Developments.title: GenAI to reshape workforce, GCCs to cushion job impact
Major AI Developments.summary: GenAI is expected to transform India's labor market over the next decade by automating tasks and augmenting jobs with AI. Global capability centers will help cushion the employment impact of this shift. As a result, workers will be able to focus on more complex and higher-value tasks.

Major AI Developments.title: ANI v. OpenAI: User Rights, Fair Dealing, and the Future of AI in Indian Copyright Law (Part I)
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indian court has ruled in favor of OpenAI in the ANI v. OpenAI case, determining that OpenAI's use of ANI's copyrighted works is prima facie non-infringing. This judgment, pronounced on July 24, 2026, marks a significant day in Indian IP history, emphasizing public interest and user rights. The ruling is an interim order, highlighting the court's efforts to balance copyright protection with fair use and public interest.

Major AI Developments.title: OnePlus N6X: India sale begins August 4; 120Hz display, AI photo tools confirmed - Check other specs
Major AI Developments.summary: OnePlus has confirmed the N6X will go on sale in India on August 4. The device features a 120Hz display and AI-powered photo editing tools. The sale date and key specs have been officially revealed by the company.

Major AI Developments.title: India scores high on semiconductor sector but modest in tech sovereignty: Forrester
Major AI Developments.summary: India is expected to significantly improve its semiconductor sovereignty by 2030, but its overall tech independence remains modest. Forrester reports that achieving broader technology independence will require investments in areas like AI, cloud, and data centres. Continued investments in these sectors, as well as talent and strategic partnerships, are necessary for India's tech growth.

Major AI Developments.title: Instamart gets a new CEO; Antler India bets on AI, climate tech
Major AI Developments.summary: Quick commerce is experiencing growth, with market leaders like Blinkit, Instamart, and Zepto expanding their networks. Amazon and Flipkart are also increasing their quick-commerce services. Instamart has appointed a new CEO amidst this expansion.

Major AI Developments.title: BharatGen CEO On Why Models Alone Can’t Help India Gain In The AI Race
Major AI Developments.summary: BharatGen's CEO believes that models alone are insufficient for India to gain an advantage in the AI race. The country's homegrown foundation model initiatives are competing for talent, compute, and enterprise mindshare. To succeed, India needs a more comprehensive approach to AI development beyond just models.

Major AI Developments.title: Gen-AI to boost India's labour productivity by 0.4 percentage points annually over next decade: Goldman Sachs
Major AI Developments.summary: Gen-AI is expected to drive labour productivity growth in India, boosting it by 0.4 percentage points annually over the next decade. This growth will be driven by the increasing adoption of Generative Artificial Intelligence technologies. The impact of Gen-AI on jobs is anticipated to be uneven across different sectors in India.

Major AI Developments.title: India may need USD 350-435 billion investment in AI, data centre infrastructure by 2030
Major AI Developments.summary: India may need $350-435 billion in investments by 2030 to develop artificial intelligence and data centre infrastructure. This investment is required to support the country's growing digital economy, according to a report by OmniScience Insights Labs. The significant investment will help India build the necessary infrastructure for its expanding digital sector.

Major AI Developments.title: India's AI boom is rewarding engineers more than coders
Major AI Developments.summary: India's AI and manufacturing push is driving stronger salary growth for engineers, technical support professionals, and infrastructure roles compared to software developers. The country's next wage boom is expected to be tied to building and running AI infrastructure, backed by government investments in semiconductors, electronics, and EVs. This shift is reshaping India's job market, with non-coding roles seeing greater rewards.

Major AI Developments.title: Circular economy company Recykal invests Rs 10 Cr in Walbha Industries
Major AI Developments.summary: Recykal, a circular economy company, has invested Rs 10 crore in Walbha Industries, a biomass briquette and pellet manufacturer. This strategic investment marks Recykal's entry into the bioenergy value chain, expanding its focus beyond waste management. The partnership aims to connect Walbha's biomass production with Recykal's network of over 620 brands and manufacturers, creating a demand channel for biomass fuel.

Major AI Developments.title: Why a 'Clean' Property File Isn't Enough: How Cubictree's AI Protects Lenders from Hidden Fraud
Major AI Developments.summary: Cubictree's AI technology is being used to protect lenders from hidden fraud in India's lending system. The country's lending system is vulnerable due to fragmented records and inadequate manual checks. Cubictree's AI Property Compliant Report aims to address this issue by providing a more comprehensive and reliable verification process.

Major AI Developments.title: India is where AI gets figured out
Major AI Developments.summary: India's diverse linguistic, cultural, and digital landscape is becoming a key testing ground for artificial intelligence. The country's complex market is expected to play a crucial role in developing AI that can understand context, intent, and human behavior. India's unique environment is poised to drive global AI innovation as the technology shifts from showcasing capabilities to solving real-world problems.

Major AI Developments.title: Amazon's Machine learning Summer School turns five, over 12,000 students trained in AI/ML skills across India
Major AI Developments.summary: Amazon India's Machine Learning Summer School has trained over 12,000 students in AI/ML skills since its inception. The free virtual program has seen significant growth in registrations since 2021, bridging academic learning with industry-ready skills. Alumni of the program have gone on to secure roles at Amazon and other leading technology firms.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-led underwriting is the missing link in India’s MSME credit story
Major AI Developments.summary: India's MSME credit gap is estimated to be Rs 25-30 lakh crore, with only 36 million of the 87 million registered MSMEs having taken a formal loan. This highlights a significant credit gap in the sector, underscoring the need for innovative solutions. AI-led underwriting is being explored as a potential solution to address this gap.

Major AI Developments.title: How to run B2B GTM when your buyer asks ChatGPT first
Major AI Developments.summary: Alon Waks, CMO at SpotDraft, shares insights on effective B2B go-to-market strategies, particularly when buyers consult AI tools like ChatGPT first. He discusses what works for Indian founders entering the US market and the impact of AI on B2B buying. Waks' expertise is featured in an episode of the Prime Venture Partners podcast.

Major AI Developments.title: Why voice, not keyboards, may define AI's next chapter
Major AI Developments.summary: The artificial intelligence race is shifting focus from model size to user interaction, with voice interfaces expected to replace keyboards for many digital tasks. India's linguistic diversity presents an opportunity for multilingual conversational AI innovation, which can benefit industries like retail, banking, and healthcare. Voice AI's success will ultimately depend on trust and natural human-like interactions.

Major AI Developments.title: Infosys names new CEO; Helping small farmers earn more
Major AI Developments.summary: Infosys has reported a 14% revenue growth in Q1, driven in part by strong AI momentum. The company has trimmed its FY27 guidance due to macro uncertainty. Infosys also announced a new CEO, although details about the appointment were not specified.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT (ISM) scientist wins prestigious Oxford AI fellowship
Major AI Developments.summary: A scientist from IIT (ISM) has been awarded a prestigious AI fellowship at Oxford. This fellowship is a notable recognition of the scientist's work in the field of artificial intelligence. The achievement highlights the institution's growing reputation for producing talented researchers in AI.

Major AI Developments.title: 26% of surveyed manufacturers plan to increase Physical AI investment: TCS study
Major AI Developments.summary: A recent TCS study found that 26% of surveyed manufacturers plan to increase their investment in Physical AI. None of the surveyed organizations intend to reduce their Physical AI investments, indicating a commitment to long-term transformation. This suggests that manufacturers are prioritizing sustained growth over short-term gains through Physical AI adoption.

Major AI Developments.title: Utho Cloud to deploy 10,000 GPUs over two years to expand AI infrastructure in India
Major AI Developments.summary: Utho Cloud plans to deploy 10,000 GPUs over two years to expand AI infrastructure in India. The deployment will feature Nvidia H200, H100, and Blackwell GPUs, offering sovereign AI infrastructure. This move promises to provide up to 60% lower pricing than hyperscalers.

Major AI Developments.title: 75% of India's AI infrastructure relies on global supply chain: Red Hat's Navtez Bal
Major AI Developments.summary: 75% of India's AI infrastructure relies on a global supply chain, according to Navtez Bal of Red Hat. The company views the India market as a key opportunity, particularly in sovereign AI and virtualisation. Red Hat aims to drive innovation in India through its core portfolio, focusing on these areas.

Major AI Developments.title: 85% of Indian finance leaders under pressure to prove AI ROI as governance lags: Survey
Major AI Developments.summary: A survey found that 85% of Indian finance leaders face pressure to demonstrate the return on investment (ROI) of artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives. This pressure exists despite organisations prioritising rapid AI deployment over governance. Indian finance leaders are struggling to balance swift implementation with proving the value of AI investments.

Major AI Developments.title: 75% of India's AI infrastructure relies on global supply chain: Red Hat's Navtez Bal
Major AI Developments.summary: Seventy-five percent of India's AI infrastructure relies on a global supply chain, according to Navtez Bal of Red Hat. The company views the Indian market as a key opportunity, particularly in sovereign AI and virtualization. Red Hat aims to drive innovation in India through its core portfolio, focusing on these areas.

Major AI Developments.title: Now, it’s AI cost control, and a move beyond LLMs
Major AI Developments.summary: Companies are shifting their focus to controlling AI costs and securing sensitive data, while also facing challenges with GPU access and hardware utilization. The industry is exploring AI applications beyond large language models, driven by the need for more efficient and cost-effective solutions. India's technical talent is well-positioned to support future growth in AI infrastructure.

Major AI Developments.title: Soket AI Wants To Turn The Language Gap In AI Into India’s Edge
Major AI Developments.summary: Soket AI aims to leverage the language gap in AI to India's advantage. The company is working to improve AI models for Indian languages, which currently lag behind English in terms of capabilities. By doing so, Soket AI hopes to turn this gap into an opportunity for India to take the lead in AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: The geopolitics of AI: Why WAICO matters
Major AI Developments.summary: China's formation of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO) marks a significant shift in the global AI landscape, potentially leading to new alignments among nations. Developing countries may favor China's affordable open-source AI frameworks over Western alternatives, intensifying the race for AI supremacy. This development poses a challenge for India, which must balance its economic goals with the need for strategic self-reliance.

Major AI Developments.title: AI meter is running. India's IT clients are rethinking their models
Major AI Developments.summary: India's IT clients are rethinking their AI models as enterprise AI consumption increases. They are shifting routine work to smaller AI models and reserving larger ones for complex tasks. This shift aims to optimize AI usage and efficiency.

Major AI Developments.title: AI to fuel India's tech services growth; public cloud spending to reach USD 17.5 bn in 2026
Major AI Developments.summary: India's tech services sector is expected to experience strong growth driven by AI, with public cloud spending projected to reach $17.5 billion by 2026. This represents a 28.1% year-on-year increase, according to Equirus Securities. The surge in public cloud spending is a key indicator of the sector's AI-led growth.

Major AI Developments.title: How AI Is becoming the operating system of mobility infrastructure powered by real-time infrastructure intelligence
Major AI Developments.summary: India's mobility infrastructure has rapidly expanded, and the next step is the integration of an intelligence layer powered by real-time data. This intelligence layer, driven by AI, is expected to become the operating system of mobility infrastructure. When fully implemented, it will likely feel like a seamless and natural part of the system, rather than a new technology.

Major AI Developments.title: Google I/O Connect India 2026: India to get its first AI university, announced at this flagship event; all you need to know
Major AI Developments.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced the state's plan to establish India's first AI university at the Google I/O Connect India 2026 event. The initiative aims to build a robust AI ecosystem in the region. The announcement marks a significant step towards promoting AI education and innovation in India.

Major AI Developments.title: AI innovation is accelerating - Can India's data protection keep pace?
Major AI Developments.summary: Artificial intelligence is being rapidly adopted in India, offering benefits across various industries and governance. To ensure responsible AI deployment, organizations must prioritize data protection and infrastructure security, adhering to the DPDP Act's requirements. Companies must integrate security and compliance into AI projects from the outset to protect data and maintain accountability.

Major AI Developments.title: Beyond the hype: Building real leadership in the age of AI
Major AI Developments.summary: Ambitious companies often confuse energy with substance in their AI adoption, leading to excitement without clear outcomes. True leadership in the age of AI requires defining success with measurable business results and a clear vision. Indian leaders must prioritize tangible value over mere visibility in their AI initiatives to achieve sustainable results.

Major AI Developments.title: How AI is rewriting India’s credit story
Major AI Developments.summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming India's credit landscape by reducing the cost of evaluating borrowers. This enables lenders to serve customer segments that were previously challenging to assess. AI is making it possible for lenders to responsibly extend credit to new groups of customers.

Major AI Developments.title: Google launches new AI tools, partnerships to support India’s AI ecosystem
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has launched new AI tools and partnerships to support the development of India's AI ecosystem. The move aims to foster growth and innovation in the country's artificial intelligence sector. This initiative is part of Google's efforts to expand its presence and investment in India's technology industry.

Major AI Developments.title: AI, automation to reshape maritime workforce as India eyes global shipping hub: Maritime University officials
Major AI Developments.summary: India is poised to become a global shipping hub, driven by advancements in AI, automation, and green shipping technologies. Major AI Developments.summary: Reliance Industries (RIL) is investing heavily in artificial intelligence (AI) to drive growth in its entertainment business. Major AI Developments.title: India well-positioned to become global leader in multilingual, multimodal AI solutions
Major AI Developments.summary: India is poised to become a global leader in Artificial Intelligence innovation, particularly in multilingual and multimodal AI solutions. Major AI Developments.summary: India's CDMO sector has seen a 178% increase in demand for AI-linked skills over two years, driven by the adoption of AI-enabled hiring. Major AI Developments.summary: Tata Elxsi has launched AnaTel, an AI platform designed for medical software and compliance. Major AI Developments.summary: India's CDMO sector has seen a significant shift in hiring towards AI-enabled capabilities, with a 178% increase in AI-linked skill demand over the past two years. Major AI Developments.title: AI to turbocharge patent creation at India tech hubs, executives say
Major AI Developments.summary: Global companies expect AI to accelerate new product and intellectual property creation at Indian tech hubs, driving complex innovation. India's skilled workforce and cost advantages are attracting investment, despite regulatory hurdles slowing local patent filings. This is poised to position India's tech centers for high-value work and increased innovation.

Major AI Developments.title: Samsung Brings 2026 Vision AI TV Lineup in India
Major AI Developments.summary: Samsung has launched its 2026 Vision AI TV lineup in India, expanding its presence in the country's television market. Major AI Developments.summary: PhysicsWallah's revenue increased by 35% to Rs 3,900 Cr in FY26, driven by growth in paid users and offline expansion. Major AI Developments.summary: India's FMCG sector is undergoing a significant transformation driven by Artificial Intelligence, which is revolutionizing consumer demand understanding, product quality, and customer connections. AI is expected to boost growth and efficiency across the industry, with companies investing in the technology to gain a competitive edge. This shift is driven by the need to meet evolving consumer needs and stay ahead in the market.

Major AI Developments.title: Acer India Unveils New Aspire 5 AI Laptop Powered by Intel Core...
Major AI Developments.summary: Acer India has launched the new Aspire 5 AI laptop, which is powered by Intel Core. The Aspire 5 AI laptop aims to deliver a superior computing experience with its advanced features and Intel Core processing.

Major AI Developments.title: OPPO India expands its Find X9 Series with Next-Generation Imaging and AI...
Major AI Developments.summary: OPPO India has expanded its Find X9 Series, incorporating next-generation imaging and AI capabilities. Major AI Developments.summary: Pronto's physical AI training pilot is under scrutiny for its potential impact on India's privacy rules. Major AI Developments.summary: HCLTech has expanded its partnership with Pegasystems to enhance AI-led legacy modernisation. This partnership aims to reduce disruption and accelerate the modernisation process for businesses.

Major AI Developments.title: AI transformation succeeds when enterprises simplify systems and align people: Mahindra, Airbus and Tata Motors leaders
Major AI Developments.summary: Technology leaders from Mahindra Group, Airbus, and Tata Motors emphasized that AI transformation is successful when enterprises simplify their systems and align their people. Major AI Developments.title: How AI-led CX can deliver revenue and trust
Major AI Developments.summary: At the ETCIO Annual Conclave 2026, industry leaders discussed the importance of AI-led customer experience in driving revenue and trust. Major AI Developments.title: AI must be treated as a multi-year operating model shift: Ratan Kumar, Central Bank of India
Major AI Developments.summary: Ratan Kumar of the Central Bank of India emphasized the need to treat AI as a long-term operating model shift. Banks should move beyond isolated AI pilots and integrate governance, accountability, and orchestration into their workflows. This approach will enable banks to scale AI in a responsible and sustainable manner.

Major AI Developments.summary: India's CIOs believe that the value of AI will come from process readiness rather than the speed of adoption. They noted that boards are now asking tougher questions about AI's return on investment, security, governance, and measurable business impact.

Major AI Developments.title: Why AI-ready digital cores must be built with purpose, governance and context
Major AI Developments.summary: Leaders from top companies discussed the importance of building AI-ready digital cores with purpose, governance, and context at the ETCIO Annual Conclave 2026. They emphasized that cloud strategy must align with business resilience, data quality, AI readiness, and scalable enterprise advantage. Key companies represented included Bajaj Allianz, Kotak Life Insurance, and ICICI Bank, among others.

Major AI Developments.title: Agentic AI will scale only when enterprises redesign processes, say tech leaders
Major AI Developments.summary: Tech leaders at the ETCIO Annual Conclave 2026 stated that enterprises must redesign their processes to scale Agentic AI. This involves fixing workflows, defining measurable outcomes, and building governance for autonomous systems. Leaders from companies like Axis Max Life Insurance and Adani Group emphasized the need to move beyond AI pilots to achieve this.

Major AI Developments.title: Governance is BFSI’s competitive advantage in scaling AI, say Indian banking leaders
Major AI Developments.summary: Indian banking leaders stated that governance is a key competitive advantage for the BFSI sector in scaling AI. They emphasized that AI adoption must be based on explainability, auditability, data quality, and customer trust. This comes as banks transition from pilot projects to large-scale AI deployments.

Major AI Developments.title: BWSSB to host India’s first National AI and Digital Water Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: The Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) is set to host India's first National AI and Digital Water Summit. The summit aims to bring together experts and stakeholders to discuss innovative solutions for water management.

Major AI Developments.summary: Newgen Software has outlined its AI-era vision for the NewgenONE platform, which integrates workflows, content, and AI agents into a single governed execution layer. It aims to help enterprises, particularly in financial services, streamline processes such as onboarding, trade finance, and mortgage processing.

Major AI Developments.title: As OpenAI and Anthropic soar, where do India’s AI startups stand?
Major AI Developments.summary: India's AI startups are struggling to develop foundational models, relying on US technology, while global players like OpenAI and Anthropic pursue massive IPOs. This has resulted in limited advancements in India's AI sector. The country's AI landscape remains stagnant compared to global counterparts.

Major AI Developments.title: Don’t fear AI, but don’t trust it blindly: CJI Surya Kant
Major AI Developments.summary: Chief Justice Surya Kant advises judges to use AI cautiously, recognizing its potential to aid human judgment without replacing it. He warns against over-reliance on AI due to risks such as inaccuracies and misuse. Kant emphasizes the importance of maintaining judicial independence and upholding constitutional values when utilizing AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Indian digital ad market likely to double to USD 22 billion by 2030
Major AI Developments.summary: India's digital advertising market is projected to double to $22 billion by 2030, outpacing the broader economy. Mobile advertising is expected to continue dominating the market, with a focus on privacy, AI, and data driving future growth. This expansion will favor companies that adapt to these emerging trends and technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Bigbasket appoints Arpit Jaiswal as Chief Growth Officer
Major AI Developments.summary: BigBasket has appointed Arpit Jaiswal as its Chief Growth Officer to drive profitable growth and category leadership. He will focus on deepening customer engagement, driving monetization efficiency, and scaling BigBasket's presence in urban and emerging markets.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Startups To Watch: 5 Indian AI Startups That Caught Our Eye In April
Major AI Developments.summary: India's AI ecosystem faced challenges in April, despite OpenAI's dominance with a $122 Bn valuation.
