Major AI Developments.summary: Intellithink, an industrial AI startup, has raised Rs 17 crore in a seed round led by Pentathlon Ventures, with participation from Anicut Capital and Veltis Capital. The company will use the funds to expand its customer base across India and the Middle East. Intellithink's AI platform focuses on machine health and energy efficiency, providing predictive maintenance, remote monitoring, and fault diagnosis solutions.

India's high AI adoption rate places it among the world's leading countries in this field.

Major AI Developments.summary: Freshworks is hosting a webinar on managing IT complexity in the age of AI. The webinar aims to help organizations deliver more without adding complexity. It will focus on adopting AI, streamlining operations, and driving measurable impact.

Major AI Developments.summary: Lumio has launched its Vision 9 (2026) smart TVs in India, featuring enhanced performance and immersive viewing capabilities. Major AI Developments.title: Entry-level IT roles down 20–25% as AI pushes India toward specialised hiring
Major AI Developments.summary: India's IT industry is experiencing a shift with entry-level roles decreasing by 20-25% due to AI. Meanwhile, demand is increasing for higher-skilled jobs, creating a gap between job opportunities and workforce preparedness. This transition is driven by the growing use of AI, which is automating routine tasks and changing the industry's hiring needs.

Major AI Developments.title: GobbleCube raises $15 Mn in Series A round led by Susquehanna
Major AI Developments.summary: GobbleCube, an AI-based brand analytics platform, has raised $15 million in a Series A funding round led by Susquehanna Venture Capital. The round also saw participation from existing investors InfoEdge Ventures and Kae Capital, adding to the $3.5 million raised in a pre-Series A round in July 2025. The funds will be used for product development, hiring, and expanding its global presence, as well as advancing its AI capabilities.

Major AI Developments.title: AI boom yet to lift global productivity: IMF
Major AI Developments.summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) states that the current AI boom has not yet led to a significant increase in global productivity. According to IMF Chief Economist Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas, current macroeconomic data does not reflect the impact of AI adoption. The IMF is still waiting to see the effects of AI on global productivity in the available data.

Major AI Developments.title: Infosys rolls out 'silicon to application' AI strategy
Major AI Developments.summary: Infosys has launched a "silicon to application" AI strategy, partnering with Nvidia and Intel at the silicon layer. The move aims to support clients' specific requirements, including latency and cost optimization.

Major AI Developments.title: Swiss HQ QAI Ventures aims to partner with India’s quantum AI startups
Major AI Developments.summary: QAI Ventures, a Swiss-based VC firm, is seeking to partner with Indian startups in the quantum AI space. Major AI Developments.summary: India's court case ANI v OpenAI has reserved judgment, potentially setting a precedent for copyright implications of generative AI. The case questions whether AI systems like OpenAI's process information in new ways or unlawfully appropriate protected expression. The judgment will address issues such as chatbot web search functionality and memorization, which are central to the copyright infringement debate.

Major AI Developments.title: Accel raises $5 Bn for AI and late-stage bets
Major AI Developments.summary: Accel is raising $4 billion for its Leaders Fund to invest in late-stage startups globally, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The total funds raised amount to $5 billion, which will be deployed across growth-stage startups with a key focus on AI.

Major AI Developments.summary: India is among the world's most advanced AI markets, according to OpenAI, driven by strong growth in coding and data analysis. OpenAI's assessment highlights India's potential for further AI development and adoption.

Major AI Developments.summary: India's development of artificial intelligence infrastructure is expected to enhance regional AI capacity. The move is likely to bolster the overall tech ecosystem in the region.

Major AI Developments.summary: India's micro, small, and medium enterprises can leverage artificial intelligence to enhance growth and compete globally.
